instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a parity generator/checker circuit for even and odd parity. 
The circuit should have one input signal and one output signal. The input signal is a binary value and the output signal is a single bit that indicates whether the number of ones in the input signal is even or odd.

Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a single input signal (in)
Outputs: a single output signal (out)

Your module should implement the following functionality:

If the input signal has an even number of ones, the output signal should be a logic 1.
If the input signal has an odd number of ones, the output signal should be a logic 0.
To implement the parity generator/checker, you should use Verilog code to count the number of ones in the input signal and determine whether it is even or odd. 
You should then assign the appropriate value to the output signal based on the parity of the input signal.
